transcript.text: Good morning everyone. We need to get next week's sustainment-training board finalized and published by 1600 today. Before I sign it, I need to hear from the S-3 and the motor pool chief on any schedule or readiness changes. Specifically, I need to confirm whether all six training trucks will be released and available for the driver-certification block, which is normally Tuesday morning. What's the current status?
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: Sir, I need to flag a schedule change. I received a higher-headquarters tasking this morning requiring 2nd Platoon to complete a radio-procedures refresher on Wednesday from 1300 to 1500, with an attendance roster submitted afterward. This tasking is still being entered into the battalion training tracker and is not yet on the briefing slide, so it won't show up in the normal review.

transcript.text: Sir, I need to report a readiness change. During this morning's inspection, I confirmed that only four of the six assigned training trucks have completed brake inspections. The other two will not be released until Friday at 0800. They must remain on hold until their inspections are complete, and this inspection status has not yet been posted to the training board. So for a Tuesday morning driver-certification block, we would only have four trucks available, not the standard six.
